metadata.parks_source: Tokyo Green Open Data, released 2026-02-02; park records include source dates that vary by layer
metadata.trees_source: Tokyo Green Open Data street-tree GIS; Tokyo-managed ward-road trees are points, municipal route totals are apportioned by clipped route length
metadata.osm_source: OpenStreetMap API snapshot retrieved 2026-09-27; cafe, toilet, pedestrian-space mapping is community mapped
caveats: Public-space ratio uses open-area polygons for parks and open sections; it is not green-cover ratio and excludes fee-based gardens, zoos, cemeteries, and planned/unopened areas.
Street-tree density includes Tokyo-managed tree points plus an estimate from ward-road route totals; national roads and any unmapped or unavailable tree records are not included.
OpenStreetMap cafe and toilet counts reflect mapped features, not a complete business or municipal facility register. Explicitly private or customer-only toilets are excluded.
Pedestrian length includes mapped footways, pedestrian streets, paths, and steps. Vehicle carriageways are excluded; density does not measure sidewalk width or pedestrian volume.
